common_protocol.scope: Prior common protocols govern evidence/revision/request identity, per-feature criteria, independent semantic review, native/remote uncertain completion, malformed outputs and affected-only invalidation. All action procedures/helpers and future tests remain proposals.
common_protocol.frames: Every transform records source and destination frame IDs/revisions, coordinate units, handedness/axis order, matrix storage/application convention, direction, inverse and composition order. Rigid transform permits rotation/translation; similarity adds explicitly justified positive uniform scale. Unit conversion, origin shift and survey/map conversion retain separate records. Reflections and nonuniform deformation require their own explicit model rather than entering rigid/similarity fitting.
common_protocol.camera: Intrinsics describe image projection and distortion for the exact camera/lens/focus/image grid; extrinsics describe pose. Store crop/resize/undistort mappings, actual new intrinsics/distortion convention and pixel-center convention. OpenCV pose maps object/world to camera; inverse is separately identified. Calibration target units set its pose translation scale and do not calibrate an unrelated reconstruction. Held-out calibration views require known pose or pose fitting from a designated subset with separate evaluation points and frozen intrinsics.
common_protocol.registration: Source and target cloud roles have separate immutable revisions. Coarse and refined transforms map source to target; record whether an API returns full or incremental transform. Preserve sampled-to-original indices, masks/normals/tessellation settings, dynamic/occluded/non-overlap regions and source density. State which pose freedoms the observed geometry can constrain; unresolved freedoms retain alternatives.
common_protocol.metrics: Source engineering allowance, measurement/sensor/control uncertainty, fit objective/threshold, parameter uncertainty and numerical/export threshold are separate quantities. The inspected Open3D 0.20.0 ICP tutorial defines fitness as inlier correspondences divided by source point count and inlier_rmse in coordinate-length units. Every selected adapter/version records its actual metric definition/denominator; other metrics retain their own definitions. Directed cloud/mesh differences name compared/reference order, sampling, search limits and valid/excluded counts. Signed distance needs supported orientation/geometry. Independent feature/control checks remain separate from fitting points, and same-capture withheld samples retain shared dependence.
common_protocol.branches: Branch records share source revisions, feature/control IDs and frames while retaining intended use, required coverage/detail, source subset, criteria and local/remote/manual costs. VLM receives original full views/located regions, actual cloud/geometry views and numeric reports. It selects evidence-supported associations within current intent; nominal, observed and idealized dimensions retain distinct meanings. Merged artifact gets new revision and repeated independent metric/semantic/readback checks.
common_protocol.resources: Begin with metadata, known controls, coarse/static regions and required interfaces before dense full-resolution distances or candidate sweeps. CPU/RAM estimates name images/points/features/faces/iterations; local GPU role belongs to the selected backend. Remote inference tokens/calls/latency/cost and manual landmark/segmentation/metrology effort are recorded separately. Actual benchmarks need hardware, versions, inputs and run receipts.
common_protocol.failure_resume: Retain raw observations, last validated calibration/transform/model, all candidate/mask IDs and actual tool/model request identities. Reconcile uncertain mutation or remote response before retry; malformed model selections preserve previous artifact. On resume recheck source/calibration/CAD digests; source changes invalidate dependent poses/rays/fits/comparisons only. No automatic re-registration may conceal a CAD edit's changed geometry.
common_protocol.analytic_fits: Proposed PCL normal-assisted cylinder adapter preserves point/normal index correspondence, normal-estimation neighborhood and original sample lineage. Select SACMODEL_CYLINDER and explicit consensus/settings; decode axis point [0–2], direction [3–5] and radius [6]. Cloud units apply to coordinates, threshold and radius bounds. Tutorial numbers remain example settings. Record normal-distance criterion separately from geometric residual checks. PCL 1.15.1-dev API, mutable master header and installed release are distinct evidence. Check angular/axial coverage, normals, bound clipping, sensitivity and independent controls; source identity, finite extent, engineering allowance and parameter uncertainty have separate records.
